description:
Read a full OpenTrain proposal/candidate evaluation by proposal id: status, bid, masked candidate, AI-interview score + summary, location/identity verification, Open Label assessment, the application-stage screening standing (`screening`: LMS course + quiz status, grade state, finalized percentage/pass, course-version currency, and the `proposal:<jobOfferId>` enrollment key for the LMS review/grade/release/decide tools; `screeningRead` FAILED means unknown right now, not "not enrolled"), and contract state. Pass includeInterview: true to also fetch the sanitized AI-interview transcript. Requires proposals:read scope and preserves OpenTrain proposal privacy restrictions.
CandidateProjectEligibility is a stored job-scoped participation summary, separate from person-level identity, time-bounded currentLocation, proposal-time location snapshots, and screening results. null means no participation record is available, not eligible. evaluatedAt is the stored decision timestamp (or last evaluation), not the time of this read; use it as the freshness signal. reasonCodes are diagnostic reasons from that decision, not independent vetoes: ELIGIBLE can coexist with FULL_ID_REQUIRED or a location REVIEW_REQUIRED result under a non-enforced policy. Reads do not reevaluate the decision's freshness or grant access; active overrides are filtered for expiry at read time, and protected writes enforce current policy. DECISION_STALE is added only by the access guard; SCOPE_NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_MISMATCH and SCOPE_USER_MISMATCH are scope-resolution errors. These four codes are not emitted in this read. Always inspect identity, currentLocation and reasons separately; never infer verified identity, fresh location or permission to hire/work from this summary alone.
ELIGIBLE: The stored job-participation decision allows participation and the participation is not ON_HOLD. This is not proof of verified identity or current location: a non-enforced (including SHADOW) policy records allowed=true even when reasons identify unmet requirements.
ON_HOLD: The stored participation is ON_HOLD and no active override is projected. Do not treat it as cleared for protected work; follow the canonical hold/review flow.
INELIGIBLE: No active override or ON_HOLD state is projected, and the current decision is missing or records allowed=false. This is a job-scoped participation result, not a hiring-quality verdict or a permanent ban.
OVERRIDE_ACTIVE: An unrevoked, unexpired participation override exists. It takes precedence in this summary, but can be action-scoped; it is not blanket permission and does not turn identity or location into verified evidence.
reasonCodes catalog (diagnostic, not provider error strings):
CURRENT_LOCATION_ALLOWED: Current credible location evidence satisfies the job location policy.
CURRENT_LOCATION_OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES: Credible current evidence is outside the allowed countries; confidence/repetition determines review versus a confirmed mismatch. This requires OpenTrain review: contact OpenTrain support, and the worker must supply new evidence.
CLIENT_RESTRICTED_COUNTRY: Credible current evidence places the person in a client-restricted country. Seek human review of disputed evidence; do not bypass the client restriction.
CLIENT_RESTRICTED_REGION: Credible current evidence places the person in a client-restricted region. Seek human review of disputed evidence; do not bypass the client restriction.
ANONYMIZED_OR_AMBIGUOUS_SIGNAL: Current network/location evidence is anonymized or ambiguous and cannot establish allowed physical presence. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location without a VPN or proxy. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
CONFLICTING_CURRENT_SIGNALS: Credible current signals disagree on country alongside an outside-allowed-country signal. This requires OpenTrain review: contact OpenTrain support, and the worker must supply new evidence.
INSUFFICIENT_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: There is not enough usable current evidence to establish location. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
STALE_LOCATION_EVIDENCE: Recorded location observations are no longer usable as current evidence. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
ACTIVE_HOLD_REQUIRES_REVIEW: An existing location hold needs explicit review/challenge; a later passive signal alone does not clear it.
PROVIDER_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Current provider evidence is unavailable; independent usable evidence has not established location. Wait for provider recovery or seek human review; do not treat an outage as clearance.
FULL_ID_REQUIRED: Full identity is required by the job policy but has not been verified or requested. Request full identity verification from the proposal in the OpenTrain app; the worker then completes it. No public API or MCP operation can request it.
FULL_ID_IN_PROGRESS: Required full identity verification is requested or in progress; it is not yet verified. Wait for the pending verification result.
FULL_ID_FAILED: Required full identity verification failed. Seek human review before any permitted retry; do not infer clearance.
FULL_ID_EXPIRED: Required full identity verification has expired. Re-request full identity verification.
FULL_ID_NEEDS_REVIEW: Required full identity needs review, including a provider-approved record whose full-identity evidence is incomplete. Provider approval alone is not sufficient. Seek human identity review.
SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: The requested job/contract/proposal participation scope could not be resolved. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
SCOPE_MISMATCH: The supplied scope identifiers do not resolve to the same job/participation context. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
SCOPE_USER_MISMATCH: The supplied person does not match the resolved participation scope. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
DECISION_MISSING: The participation has no current eligibility decision; this is not evidence of clearance.
DECISION_STALE: The decision is stale for the current policy/evidence or time window and needs reevaluation. Access-guard code only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read. Use evaluatedAt as the freshness signal.

includeInterview.description: Set true to also fetch the sanitized AI-interview transcript (interviewer/candidate messages) for deeper candidate evaluation.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal/job offer id to read.
